scenarios.name: face-down-land-from-the-top-is-a-creature-spell
scenarios.why: The Horde lets its controller cast creature spells from the top; a face-down morph counts as a creature spell even though the card is a land, so it can be cast for three and arrives as a 2/2.

scenarios.name: bestow-card-on-top-castable-only-as-a-creature
scenarios.why: With the Horde out, a bestow creature on top of the library can be cast from there as an ordinary creature spell for its mana cost; it arrives as a 1/1 lifelink creature.

scenarios.name: bestow-card-on-top-cannot-be-cast-bestowed
scenarios.why: The Horde only allows creature spells from the top of the library, and a bestowed cast is not a creature spell, so with a creature to enchant and enough mana the top card is offered as an ordinary cast but not as a bestow cast.
